subject.title: feat(mac): mascot accessory pack — nightcap, grad cap, hat-tip exit

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the shared public `OpenClawMascotAccessory` API and ship the nightcap, graduation-cap, and working-exit hat-tip behaviors as default macOS mascot design?
rationale: The implementation appears bounded, but code review cannot decide whether this additional public surface and visual personality should become a supported product direction.

options.title: Accept after native proof
options.body: Approve the accessory API and all three behaviors, contingent on real macOS app proof covering the interactive and Reduce Motion paths.

options.title: Keep accessories internal
options.body: Retain the visual behaviors but avoid a public shared parameter until another app consumer demonstrates a stable API need.

options.title: Decline the accessory pack
options.body: Keep the existing working-mascot implementation without adding more default headwear or transition behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept after native proof
recommendation.body: Approve the accessory API and all three behaviors, contingent on real macOS app proof covering the interactive and Reduce Motion paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merged feature history identifies this person as the clearest available owner of the mascot animation and macOS integration surface.
